title: One descended finite quotient and its algebraic geometric fibre
statement: For a scheme X, adic coefficient datum d on A, coefficient maps phi, completed derived module M, an X-etale chart V with point v, and one index n, record a bounded etale complex L over ULift(A/I^(n+1)) with finite locally constant cohomology, a small perfect algebraic complex F, and an isomorphism from the exact derived geometric stalk of L at the algebraic closure of v to the exact module-universe lift of F [def-weil-pbc-geometric-stalks, def-constructible-locally-constant, def-pc-perfect-ring-complex]. For every U etale over V and every small algebraic G, a supplied isomorphism from L restricted to U to the constant universe lift of G must transport, after any X-etale arrow W to U, to an isomorphism from the actual nth quotient of M to the completed constant realization of G on W [def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum, def-weil-pbc-finite-perfect-adic-tower-data, def-weil-pbc-ringed-site-derived-restriction]. The module-universe lift is constructed termwise from ModuleCat.uliftFunctor and restriction along the ULift ring equivalence, then passed to the derived category. The geometric stalk functor is the exact derived sheaf fibre. This is a data type, with no existence assertion and no comparisons between coefficient levels.
